title: Joseph's pure conscience and natural law
english: So were you managing to keep a pure conscience toward the one who had acquired you, not even willing to perform the deed so called by name, and choosing instead to defend the natural law in yourself? You were tested while practicing an extreme of self-control. Reuben and Judah gave the best advice—but it was different, for they were dealing with savage men.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
orientation: Eustathius continues addressing Joseph directly, asking whether he kept his conscience pure toward his master and defended a natural law in himself, then contrasts this with the advice of Reuben and Judah.

title: Simeon and Levi's taste for murder
english: For Simeon and Levi and their company had tasted murder in no small measure, and by now they had made a settled habit of the deed; they even longed to go creeping around the scent of blood.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
orientation: Eustathius is contrasting Joseph's self-control with the violent habits of his brothers Simeon and Levi.

title: The boldness of Simeon and Levi in slaughtering the Shechemites
english: They were such bold and reckless men that, like hunters on a scent, they slaughtered the Shechemites all alone, tribe by tribe (Genesis 34:25).
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
orientation: Eustathius is contrasting Joseph's self-control with the murderous boldness of his brothers Simeon and Levi, who slaughtered the Shechemites.
